description: Form 1040 (2025), line 7b: the affirmative Schedule-D-not-required disposition for the direct line-7a route (ADR-0050 Decision 5). Publishes only from the current checked conclusion tax.us.2025.schedule-d-required.conclusion equal to no. Exact citation pin is tax.us.2025.citation.form1040.line-7b@v1 to the 2025 Instructions for Form 1040, Line 7b, the paragraph beginning "If Exception 1 applies, check the 'Schedule D not required' box on line 7b". v3: publishes only when no sale is recorded (every sale count and covered proceeds subtotal is zero), as Form 1040 line 16 v7 reads them.

blocked.explain: Line 7b is blocked because the checked Schedule-D-required conclusion is unpublished (missing Exception-1 component authority), or because a kind of sale is not yet answered: whether you recorded any sale decides whether Schedule D is required.

closure_backed_zero.explain: Not used for the line-7b Schedule-D-not-required disposition.

computed_zero.explain: Not used for the line-7b Schedule-D-not-required disposition.

guard_inapplicable.explain: No affirmative Schedule-D-not-required disposition: you recorded a sale, which is reported on Form 8949 or Schedule D, so Exception 1 does not apply; or the checked Schedule-D-required conclusion is yes (an Exception-1 component is no).

published_value.explain: No sale is recorded and the checked Schedule-D-required conclusion is no; Exception 1 applies and the Schedule D not required box on line 7b is affirmative.

label: Schedule D not required
